newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's net reserves up $164 mln in September.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's net reserves up $164 mln in September.

text.p: The Ecuadoran Central Bank's net reserves grew by $164 million to $1.69 billion in September, a 10.7 increase over August, a government official said Wednesday.
In August, net reserves reached $1.53 billion, $17 million more than in July.
According to the official, who requested anonymity, reserves grew due to a successful participation of the Central Bank in exchange money markets and a rise in international oil prices.
Ecuador's reserves stood at $1.56 billion at the end of last year, down $145 million from the end of 1994.
